title: What do you see?
text: Blocks put together represents addition, here we see different combinations of $$3$$ and $$5$$ added.

title: Which relationship?
text: The relationship is showing that we can add $$3$$ and $$5$$ or $$5$$ and $$3$$ to get the same quantity, in this case $$8$$.

title: Putting it together
text: The relationship is the commutative rule for addition: $$a+b=b+a$$.
